# möbius Gateway 0.9.14

- Advertises provider-defined web-search choices and authoritative session-file limits to every frontend.
- Flattens the session catalog wire record after applying gateway-owned visibility metadata.
- Strengthens persisted auth and credential validation without exposing secret material.
- Routes cron commands through the owning capability and rejects them safely during gateway mutations.

Upgrade clients and the gateway together: this release uses protocol 47. Configuration 20 and chat specification 9 are unchanged.
